annotations.title: Make a QBO file from transactions

description: Use this when the user wants to convert bank statement rows to a QBO, OFX or QIF file from rows they pasted, typed or showed in a statement photo or table: "convert csv to qbo", "bank statement to qbo converter". First convert what the user gave into transaction objects (date, description, signed amount or withdrawal/deposit, optional balance and check number); pass raw text in `text` only if you cannot. Returns QBO, OFX 1.0.2, OFX 2, QIF, QuickBooks CSV and an Excel review sheet with unique FITIDs and the ending balance. Do not use when a statement file is attached (use convert_statement_to_qbo); does not connect to banks or QuickBooks.

account_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the account (or any short label) used as the account id QuickBooks links to, e.g. 4821. Default 0000. Never send the full account number.

account_type.description: checking (default), savings, money_market, credit_card or line_of_credit. auto reads it from a PDF statement. Example: credit_card.

bank_id.description: Optional BANKID for the OFX files: the bank's 9-digit ABA number printed on checks, e.g. 121000248. Default 000000000.

closing_balance.description: Ending balance for LEDGERBAL, e.g. "$5,034.47". If unknown, the files say so (see result).

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. USD (default), CAD, GBP.

date_order.description: Order of numeric dates: MDY (default, US) or DMY. Detected from the file when a day is above 12.

intu_bid.description: QuickBooks Web Connect bank id (INTU.BID) for the .qbo file. Default 3000. Use the id of your own bank if QuickBooks Desktop asks for a supported bank.

opening_balance.description: Opening balance if the file has none, e.g. 4123.55. With closing_balance it proves no row is missing.

qif_date_format.description: Date order inside the QIF file: MDY (default, Quicken US) or DMY (Quicken UK, MoneyDance in Europe).

statement_year.description: Year for dates printed without one, e.g. 2026.

text.description: Fallback only: pasted statement text or CSV when you cannot build the objects.

amount.description: Signed amount: money in positive, money out (and card charges) negative, e.g. -82.17. Or use withdrawal/deposit.

balance.description: Running balance after the row if printed, e.g. 4078.45.

deposit.description: Money in (credit, payment to a card) as a positive number, e.g. 2450.

description.description: Payee or description as printed, e.g. GREENLEAF MARKET #221.

withdrawal.description: Money out (debit, charge) as a positive number, e.g. 82.17.

transactions.description: Rows as objects in statement order, e.g. [{"date":"09/02/2026","description":"PAYROLL ACME INC","amount":2450},{"date":"09/03/2026","description":"GREENLEAF MARKET","amount":-82.17}]. Pasted CSV text is also accepted.
